_how_to: A deck template for Dose. Change the title, views and cards, delete these _how_to notes if you like, and import it on the New deck page.
slug: the deck's web address (letters, numbers, dashes). Importing a pack with the same slug again updates that deck and keeps its pictures and everyone's progress.
facets: the views every card has, up to 8, like a tree's overall look, bark and leaf. Each card gets one picture per view.
facets.key: a short id for the view, used in cues and queries below. label: what the view is called on screen.
facets.queries: Wikimedia Commons searches for the view's pictures. {search} becomes the card's search name (else its subtitle, else its name) and {name} its name.
facets.must: words a good picture's title usually has ("bark", "trunk"); pictures without them rank lower.
facets.inat: true to also take iNaturalist's photos of the species (living things only; needs the scientific name as subtitle or search).

cards: up to 300. Only name is required. subtitle is a second name (a scientific name, a symbol); group is a family to filter by; wiki is the English Wikipedia article title for the summary and lead picture; search is the picture search name when it isn't the subtitle.
cards.summary: one short line to remember it by. facts: a few [label, value] pairs. cues: what to notice in each view's picture, by view key.
cards.queries: this card's own extra searches per view key, tried first, for when the view's searches find the wrong thing.

After you add the deck, Dose gathers openly licensed pictures for every card. Open a card's pictures (the pictures button on the deck page or while sailing) to choose which photo goes with which view.
